annotations.title: Create, rename or delete a media folder

description:
[Admin] Create an empty folder, rename one, or delete an empty one, when the user asked. Renaming moves every file in it to a new address: live pages keep the old one and page drafts move at once. A folder that still holds files cannot be deleted: move or delete the files first. Names: 1 to 60 letters, digits, spaces, "-", "_", ".", "(" and ")"; not starting with ".", "_" or a space, and never "profile".

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

action.description: `create` an empty folder, `rename` one with every file in it, or `delete` an empty one.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

folder.description: The folder to create, rename or delete.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional company. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

to.description: The new name. Required to rename.
